description: RAJAMAHENDRAVARAM: Union Finance Minister Nirmala Sitharaman on Sunday inaugurated the Cyient AI & Future Skills Hub at the Digital Bhavan in Pedamainvarila
body_lead: RAJAMAHENDRAVARAM: Union Finance Minister Nirmala Sitharaman on Sunday inaugurated the Cyient AI & Future Skills Hub at the Digital Bhavan in Pedamainvarilanka village of Narasapuram mandal, West Godavari district. The initiative, developed under the Cyient Foundation, aims to promote rural employment and empower youth, women, farmers, self-help groups, and local communities with AI-enabled, future-ready skills.
